sop_title: StreetSmart SOP - Certificate of Insurance (COI) Request

non_negotiables.rule: Never issue unsupported proof without verified active policy status, required endorsements, or unresolved red flags.
non_negotiables.description: Do not issue proof when coverage, policy status, written-contract conditions, forms, or red-flag requirements are deficient or unverified; route to Account Manager.

non_negotiables.rule: Never issue reinstatement proof relying solely on finance company notice without carrier or MGA confirmation.
non_negotiables.description: Reinstatement proof requires verified confirmation from the carrier portal or MGA underwriting; finance company payment receipt alone is strictly insufficient.

non_negotiables.rule: Never issue proof on uncompleted or unapproved policy changes without EZLynx entry or AM sign-off.
non_negotiables.description: Policy changes (e.g. adding vehicle/driver/coverage) must be entered and confirmed in EZLynx before certificate issuance.

non_negotiables.rule: Bypassing mandatory Carlo escalation when a certificate request remains pending over 7 days.
non_negotiables.description: Any certificate request pending over 7 days must be immediately escalated to Carlo with approved pending dropdown notices logged.

non_negotiables.rule: Never accept oral-only certificate requests without obtaining written instructions.
non_negotiables.description: Obtain written request confirming certificate holder name, address, job description, and specific required wording before issuance.

non_negotiables.rule: Never create duplicate certificate holders in EZLynx database.
non_negotiables.description: Search existing holder records, use full legal name, and update master remarks rather than creating duplicate holder entries.

checkpoints.criteria: Obtained request in writing (email/portal/text); verified client contact info and authorized third-party requester if applicable.
Verified all referenced policies are active/in-force with matching effective dates in EZLynx before preparing master.
Standard certificate processed and issued within 1 hour SLA; rush requests approved by team lead.
Applied Certificate EZLynx label, set document label Certificate of Insurance, and followed EZLynx task checklist.
Verified requested forms: Additional Insured (AI), Waiver of Subrogation (WOS), Primary/Non-Contributory, CG 2010 / CG 2037, 30-Day Cancellation Notice.
Screened for NY work, Action-Over exclusions, roofing/tree removal/excavation, and designated premises restrictions.
Screened for unlimited radius, physical damage, pollution cleanup, cargo exclusions (alcohol/steel/seafood), and verified UIIA with Mike Sosa.
Verified whether blanket AI/WOS endorsement requires an executed written contract before granting status on the certificate.
Used full legal certificate holder name; searched and reused existing database holder without creating duplicates.
Verified reinstatement on carrier site/MGA (never finance co alone); confirmed renewal payment/EFT before issuing renewal COI.
Attached actual AI/WOS endorsement forms, cited form numbers in Description of Operations, and attached ACORD 101 when creating new master.
Separated GL, On-Hook Cargo, and Physical Damage for Progressive trucking; maintained separate masters for distinct operations.
Issued via EZLynx Certificates using on-behalf-of function; verified insured is copied on all delivery emails.
Shared certificate through Client Center and educated client on 24/7 self-service certificate generation.
Created designated folder for each Certificate Master and adhered to standard naming convention.
Updated COI Forms Tracker and Pending COIs/Endorsements spreadsheet for open/in-progress items.
Immediately escalated to Carlo for any certificate pending >7 days; sent approved pending dropdown template.
Verified incoming subcontractor COIs match required limits, ongoing/completed ops, WOS, and commercial auto.
